entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Welcome home.
Honey, I'm home.
Why're you here?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You're back awfully late.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Why, you ask? I just came to enjoy some[n]delicious coffee.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: How has business been for you lately?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Take a look around.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Is the Niijima lady doing well?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Unfortunately, we haven't seen each[n]other lately.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We had a... difference of opinion.

entries.speaker: TV Host
entries.en: What are your thoughts, Representative[n]Shido?

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: It doesn't surprise me that people say[n]our country is lethargic. We've let these[n]Phantom Thieves run amok.
That man's voice...

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: And because they've targeted only[n]prominent figures, our government[n]leaders have been hesitant to act.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: I apologize for any concern they may[n]have caused and will henceforth search[n]for an apt countermeasure.

entries.speaker: Pompous Male Customer
entries.en: That politician's really honorable. I like[n]how quick he says he's gonna do[n]everything.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: This is an important undertaking, and[n]one I intend to confront with every asset[n]available to me.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: The selfish criminals enacting this[n]"social reform" are in fact the ones[n]most deserving of reformation.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Answering to the interest of the people[n]as hastily as possible is my natural duty[n]as a politician.

entries.speaker: Pompous Male Customer
entries.en: Man, this guy is admirable.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: Rampant political scandals, thieves on[n]the loose... As sad as it is, this is the state[n]of our nation.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: We must resolve this problem, and[n]I assure the people of this noble country[n]that I will do just that.
I feel I've met that man[n]somewhere before...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What're you standing there staring off[n]into space for? You're creeping me out.
It's nothing.
Don't worry about it.
You're standing too.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'm not worried or anything. You're just[n]blocking the store entrance.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'm not worried, moron. You're[n]obstructing business.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Standing here's my job.

entries.speaker: Pompous Male Customer
entries.en: That politician is honest and carries an[n]overwhelming amount of charisma.

entries.speaker: Pompous Male Customer
entries.en: It feels like a trustworthy leader for Japan[n]has finally come forth.

entries.speaker: Pompous Male Customer
entries.en: Don't you think, Boss?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Sorry, wasn't listening.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: "Criminals," hm? Well, that must be[n]how he sees it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: However, that is ignorant of their[n]true nature.
Don't like politicians?
True nature?
You on the Thieves' side?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It isn't about liking or disliking them.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It's more about how he suggests the[n]Phantom Thieves be crushed when[n]they have yet to be arrested...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If these people attack others with no[n]remorse, why would they make a teacher[n]and an artist apologize?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Could a murder truly have been enacted[n]by the same group?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It may be somewhat of a stretch to say[n]I'm "on their side."

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Having said that, I won't deny that I[n]empathize with them on some level.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If this Okumura incident was not the[n]Phantom Thieves... If they only change[n]the hearts of criminals...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Then even though they can't be[n]considered "innocent"...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Perhaps my goals are not so different[n]from theirs...
But they are innocent.
Are you a Phanboy?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hahaha.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I knew there was something special[n]about you, ever since the first time[n]we met.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I feel as though I could tell you anything[n]during our conversations.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Ah, that reminds me. I've been invited[n]to a panel at Shujin Academy, and...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh wait, I'm sure you know that already.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Considering it's such a good opportunity,[n]I've decided to accept the offer.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Thank you for the coffee. It was delicious.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Glad you liked it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm happy I could see you.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'll be going now.
I feel like I understand Akechi[n]a little more now...
